subject: Week 43: toddler immersion tour window opens — book before May 11
bodyText:
This week
Days 299–305 are motor-consolidation days: cruising smooths out, walking with hands held is common, and standing alone momentarily is emerging for some (CDC checkpoint: 12 months — https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/1-year.html). Cognitively he is hiding toys on purpose to recover them, and vocalizations now carry adult-like intonation; first specific words are emerging for some, with the CDC 2022 checkpoint for words beyond mama/dada at 15 months. Early attainment on any of these is a bonus, not the baseline.

Watch-fors this week
- [low concern] Sleep fragmentation around the mobility surge — new motor skills reliably disrupt sleep for a week or two.
- [monitor] The combination of no words, no babble, and no joint attention — document specific examples now so the 12-month-visit conversation is concrete.
- [call within 24h] Illness persisting past three days, or a fever that returns after a clear day.
- [call now] Fever ≥102°F rectal with lethargy, labored breathing, or blue lips or unresponsiveness — 911.

Enrichment opportunities
- Tour L'Academy Nob Hill this month: Mandarin immersion with Spanish enrichment from 12 months, ELFA subsidies accepted, tour-to-start lead time 1–3 months with waitlists at popular rooms — touring before the birthday sets up a month-12–13 start. Calendar Little Bee and Fun With Mandarin (both 18-month minimums) for the month-15–18 review. Live immersion is the exposure mode with high-grade evidence; the dose target is 25–30% of waking hours. L'Academy Nob Hill: https://www.lacademyschools.com/locations/san-francisco-preschool-nob-hill
- Build a cruising circuit — couch to coffee table to ottoman with 6–12-inch gaps — and let him bridge the gaps himself; unassisted bridging is the precursor to momentary standing. AAP: Movement 8 to 12 Months: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/Pages/Movement-8-to-12-Months.aspx
- Hide a toy under one of two cups and swap their positions slowly — deliberate search is this week's cognitive work, and the two-cup version scales the difficulty as he gets faster.
- Hold read-aloud at 30 minutes a day cumulative, split across three or four sittings; dialogic style — point, ask, expand — is what carries the vocabulary effect. AAP early literacy: https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/early-childhood/early-literacy/

Upcoming
- Day 300–365 (Mar 7–May 11, 2027): toddler-immersion tour window open — a tour booked before the birthday beats touring after it.
- Day 365 (Tue May 11, 2027): first birthday — pick the format now (family-only, mid-size, or venue); SF photographers for a May date book 2–4 months out, so that decision lands next week.

Developmental milestone check-in
Tap any link to mark it complete. View or change others at https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones

- Plays peekaboo (initiates by covering and uncovering face)
  AAP window: day 270-365
  What to look for: Active game initiation, not just smiling when you hide. Demonstrates object permanence in action.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/1-year.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/plays-peekaboo/complete

- Plays games like pat-a-cake
  AAP window: day 270-365
  What to look for: Imitative gesture game. Joint attention + motor imitation.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/1-year.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/plays-pat-a-cake/complete

- Waves bye-bye
  AAP window: day 270-365
  What to look for: Intentional gesture with social meaning.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/1-year.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/waves-bye/complete

- Calls a parent 'mama' or 'dada' or another name
  AAP window: day 270-365
  What to look for: Specifically referring to a person, not generalized babble. First true word for many babies.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/1-year.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/calls-parent-by-name/complete

- Understands 'no' (pauses or stops when you say it)
  AAP window: day 270-365
  What to look for: Receptive language. Compliance is a much later milestone.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/1-year.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/understands-no/complete
